priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Restore listener removal in the returned cleanup callback
findings.body: Calling the disposer no longer unregisters the message handler. Consumers that detach or repeatedly reattach will continue receiving messages through stale handlers, causing duplicate processing and retaining handler references for the socket's lifetime.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts:3 returns an empty disposer, while line 2 registers handler with socket.on. The full diff shows this PR removed socket.off("message", handler), so disposal leaves the handler active and retained.
